title: Apps for working with data from the Homer Multitext project
text:
You can download these apps and use them on your own computer, or use these installations on github pages:

Iliad + scholia reader: select passage of the Iliad and view any scholia on the selected lines
Facsimile reader: browse page images of the Venetus A, hover over indexed page to see textual edition
Interwoven diplomatic/normalized reader: read Iliad and scholia texts in diplomatic transcription with editorial normalizations in parentheses.







NoteVersions



Each app displays an individual version number. Github release versions refer to release versions of the entire repository.
For details of both github releases and individual app versions, see the release notes.
